name: Usurpatio
storyline:
In the near future, humanity no longer waits for the miracle of birth. New governments, corporations, and machines take control over the creation of life. What was once the work of nature and the divine spark becomes production. Robots live among humans. Rejected, watched, needed, and hated. The world changes its laws, its beliefs, and its sins. And when humankind usurps the act of creation, something is born that was never written in any holy book. The eighth sin. USURPATIO.

USURPATIO is a cinematic third-person science fiction game set in a near future where humanity is slowly losing the ability to create life naturally.

As birth rates collapse and death begins to outpace new life, corporations and research institutes take control of what was once left to nature. The KISH Institute becomes a symbol of hope for people who still dream of having children. Through powerful marketing, public trust, and promises of salvation, it is seen as one of the most important organizations in the world.

But behind the clean image of the institute, something darker begins to grow.

In USURPATIO, you experience one story from three different perspectives: Ren, Mark, and X13. Each of them sees the same world from a different place in the system. Their paths reveal a story about robots, artificial life, corporate power, and the dangerous moment when mankind decides to take control over creation itself.

This is a story-driven third-person action game with exploration, tension, cinematic scenes, and moments of violence. The world of USURPATIO is built around a disturbing question: what happens when creating life is no longer a miracle, but a product?

When humanity claims the act of creation, a new sin is born.
